## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

Resolve 23 isolated ExecutorTest failures from unregistered runtime-reference doubles without weakening runtime binding. Reuse Executor/ServerManager/Factory boundary; local-only runtime lookup failure normalization is lifecycle implementation detail, not a new Action. Use supervised test processes for successful doubles; assert missing runtime produces normal error response before factory/typing/status side effects. Preserve actor, scope, attachment alias and recovery assertions. Validate isolated executor plus changed PR800 group and mix q; publish separate stacked PR above #800, leave open.
title: Repair executor runtime-reference validation above PR 800
